thread:
incident-bot: ALERT: spike in policy-eval errors and routing fallbacks detected — 5xx from policy-engine up to 28% over last 5m. Multiple customers reporting degraded responses. Paging on-call. :rotating_light:

sre-oncall: acked. I’m on it, paged runtime @ava and infra @ben.

ava: seeing a ton of panics from policy evaluator. digging into logs now. stack traces look like nil deref in rule execution.

mike: I merged a policy change ~18m ago to add region-aware fallback logic (PR #4242). Could be related.

ava: found the exact panic:

```
panic: runtime error: invalid memory address or nil pointer dereference
goroutine 4321 [running]:
  github.com/redwood/routing/policy.(*Evaluator).Eval(0x0?, 0xc0001a8000)
  /workspace/redwood/routing/policy/eval.go:127 +0x1f3
  github.com/redwood/routing/policy.(*Engine).EvalAll(0xc0000b4000, 0xc0003a8000)
  /workspace/redwood/routing/policy/engine.go:88 +0x2b
```

ava: looks like a missing nil-check when evaluating nested fields (request.model.variant). some incoming requests do not include model metadata (third-party router).

ben: can we flip the policy to safe mode (disable eval+fallback) while we patch?

carla: I can apply an override to route through the baseline model for affected customers. propose temporary routing override -> route all requests to model/base-large-v1 for 30m.

ben: running command now:

```
# one-off override to force safe route
redwoodctl routing override create --scope=global --route-to=model/base-large-v1 --reason="policy-eval panic mitigation" --expires-in=30m
```

deploy-bot: override created (id=ovr-2024-09-12-18), active.

infra-bot: health metrics: policy-engine 5xx rate dropped from 28% -> 4% in 3m after override; latency normalized for most customers.

sre-oncall: good immediate improvement. marking as mitigated. we still need root cause and fix. assigning to runtime/eng-policies.

ava: root cause summary: a policy rule invoked a helper function that assumes request.model != null. policy language permits nested access without guard, which leads to panic when field absent. offending rule snippet (from PR #4242):

```
# simplified policy fragment
when request.region == "eu-west" {
  preferred = request.model.variant == "small-q4" ? "low-latency" : "balanced"
  route = choose_variant(request.model, preferred)
}
```

ava: if request.model is nil, `request.model.variant` panics. choose_variant also doesn't defensively handle nil.

mike: that PR added the rule; I missed the null-case. Sorry — my bad.

ben: plan: 1) keep override in place, 2) push a hotfix that adds nil guards in the policy runtime and the helper choose_variant, 3) add a safe-eval wrapper so policy evals return errors instead of panicking, 4) add unit tests and a pre-deploy policy fuzzer.

carla: can you push the hotfix as a canary? we should test against traffic in eu-west only first.

ava: preparing patch now. pushing a canary build and will route 1% of eu-west traffic through patched runtime.

ava: patch diff (conceptual):

```
// before
if request.model.variant == "small-q4" { ... }

// after
if request.model != nil && request.model.variant == "small-q4" { ... }
```

ben: also adding guard in choose_variant: if model==nil -> return default_variant.

deploy-bot: canary deploy started (deploy-id=canary-2387). routing rule set to test on 1% eu-west.

infra-bot: canary logs look clean. no panics observed in canary instances.

sre-oncall: metrics trend: overall 5xx now 1.2% and dropping. continuing to monitor for 30m before full rollout.

mike: i'll open PR to add policy linter to CI to catch nested-field usage without guards.

ava: also opened an internal ticket to add a runtime-level recovery wrapper so policy evals return a structured error instead of taking down the evaluator process. ticket: RDW-ops-1789.

carla: customer impact: flagged as P2 (partial outage for subset of requests). affected customers: three large tenants saw degraded responses intermittently; engineering notified account reps.

ben: communications: status updated on incident tracker: https://redwood.internal/incidents/1719009876 (created). please add any customer callbacks to that page.

sre-oncall: handoff: primary @ava offshift in 40m — handing over to @carla. carla, take ownership for the next 12h and monitor rollback/rollout.

carla: taking over. thanks. logging followups: postmortem, CI policy linter, runtime safe-eval and tests, docs for policy authors.

ava: will send a short summary to #postmortems and schedule a 1hr blameless postmortem tomorrow. :calendar: 

ben: closing notes: no data exfiltration, no config drift, mitigation successful. will follow up with a patch PR and rollout plan.

incident-bot: INCIDENT MITIGATED — routing override in place, error rate below threshold, on-call handoff complete. Incident status: mitigated -> monitoring.
